scope: Mock Lua 5.3 with stubbed natives; not an engine, editor or multiplayer test.

results.case: side winner's later death is not a loss
third loss pays 3000 with a message
a side win resets the streak
a round without troops neither pays nor changes the streak
next fielded loss continues to 3 and pays 3000
simultaneous wipe is a draw for both
queued reinforcements are not a defeat
